name: Elizovo (Sosnovka)-Vilyuchinsk Gas Pipeline
researcher_notes: Not in roster: P2424 is the 392 km Sobolevo-Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky trunk; no Vilyuchinsk row. Construction start announced 2026-09-03 at the XI Eastern Economic Forum (Gazprom deputy chairman Markelov, governor Solodov). RIA: 67.85 km, 426 mm, buried, ~27,000 m3/h design (converted ~0.24 bcm/y, 27000*8760; convert-flag, source states m3/h). AiF/kamtoday: route from Sosnovka area (Elizovsky district) to Rybachy residential district of Vilyuchinsk, skirting Krasheninnikov Bay. Serves Vilyuchinsk municipal boilers plus 12 MoD boiler plants. Sources are the same official announcement republished, so independent=false; each passes verifier and names the pipeline/value; single validated ref suffices (high). Owner: Gazprom named as sponsor; the actual owning subsidiary (e.g. a Gazprom regional gas distribution entity) not confirmed, verify. ProposalYear/FID/cost/completion date not stated; left blank. Route not found; no official GIS. Length 67.85 >= 25 km, threshold a/b/c met (Gazprom, endpoints, construction started).
